meaning: steamed minced pork with salted fish
usage: 鹹魚蒸肉餅 is a noun that refers to a specific dish made by steaming minced pork mixed with salted fish.
It is used as a menu item name in restaurants.
You can use it as the object in a sentence when talking about ordering food, for example, 'I want to eat 鹹魚蒸肉餅'.
It can also be used when discussing different pork dishes or traditional Cantonese cuisine.
In casual speech, people might shorten it to simply '鹹魚肉餅' but the full name is more common in menus.
